title: Coin Machine (Dynamic Programming)
hints: Greedy (always take the biggest coin) is wrong: with coins {1, 3, 4} and amount 6 it gives 4+1+1 = 3 coins, but 3+3 = 2.
Define best[a] = fewest coins to make amount a. Then best[a] = 1 + min over coins c <= a of best[a - c].
Fill best[0..amount] from small to large. best[0] = 0; use a big sentinel (e.g. amount + 1) for 'impossible'.
At the end, a value still equal to the sentinel means -1.
